title: Functional Entropy: Predicting Functional Correctness in LLM-Generated Code with Uncertainty Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2605.28500v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have shown impressive capabilities in code generation, yet they often produce functionally incorrect code. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods have emerged as a promising approach for detecting hallucinations in natural language generation, but their effectiveness for code generation tasks remains underexplored. We systematically evaluate how UQ techniques transfer to code generation across three programming languages, five LLMs, and over 1,700 problems. We find that some token-probability-based methods generalize effectively without modification, while sampling-based methods relying on natural language inference (NLI) fail because NLI models cannot distinguish functionally different code, causing most responses to collapse into a single semantic cluster. translated_title: 功能熵：通过不确定性量化预测大语言模型生成代码的功能正确性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在代码生成方面展现了惊人的能力，但往往生成功能不正确的代码。不确定性量化方法已成为检测自然语言生成中幻觉的有前景途径，但其在代码生成任务中的有效性尚未充分探索。我们系统评估了不确定性量化技术如何迁移到代码生成任务，涵盖三种编程语言、五个大语言模型和超过1700个问题。我们发现，一些基于令牌概率的方法无需修改即可有效泛化，而依赖自然语言推理的基于采样的方法则失败，因为自然语言推理模型无法区分功能不同的代码，导致大多数响应坍缩到单一语义簇中。为解决这一问题，我们引入了“功能等价方法”，这是一类代码特定的方法，用功能等价性替代基于自然语言推理的语义等价性。
tldr: 本文提出功能等价方法，用功能等价性替代自然语言推理，显著提升了大语言模型生成代码功能正确性的预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces functional equivalence methods that replace NLI-based semantic equivalence with functional equivalence, significantly improving the prediction of functional correctness in LLM-generated code.
